reason: A cross-agent writing skill for planning, generating, reviewing, and compiling Chinese long-form screenplays, with continuity management and local deterministic project checks.

summaries.zh: 面向兼容 Agent Skills 规范的智能体，帮助用户规划、创作、审查并编译中文电影与剧集长剧本。
summaries.en: A cross-agent skill that helps users plan, write, review, and compile long-form Chinese film and television screenplays.

capabilities: Generate and structure Chinese feature-film and television screenplays
Maintain story, character, scene, and continuity records
Build scoped writing and review context from project files
Validate, migrate, compile, and review screenplay projects using local Python scripts
